content.summary: Contract logistics company GXO (NYSE:GXO) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 7.5% year on year to $3.40 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $3.41 billion was less impressive, coming in 3.2% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.79 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
